notes.title: The Merciful Savior to Participate in the 2025 Steam Chinese New Year Sale!
notes.content:
[b]Hello, everyone![/b]

The Merciful Savior will take part in the 2025 Steam Chinese New Year Sale from January 27th to February 10th, 2025.

[h3]Don't forget add the game to your wishlist! We hope you enjoy our games![/h3]

notes.title: BLACK BOX LSS Joins the Shanghai WePlay Expo
notes.content:
[h2]WePlay Expo[/h2]
BLACK BOX LSS - The Merciful Savior will be joining the WePlay Expo in the Shanghai World Expo Exhibition & Convention Center from the 16th to the 17th of November. Come find us if you're going, too! We'll be waiting at booth C38!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309921/e83958102b387c9cdad5607e61ceb9ada66ba171.jpg[/img]

[b]Expo Details[/b]
Time: November 16-17
Address: World Expo Exhibition & Convention Center Hall H4, Floor B1, 1099 Guozhan Road, Pudong New District
Booth: C38 (specific location TBA)

Can't make it in person? Not to worry—you can still join in the fun online! During the expo, the BLACK BOX LSS - The Merciful Savior demo and the full version of BLACK BOX LSS - The Shining Immortal will also be available online for you to play!

Remember to add them to your wishlist!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2435810/BLACK_BOX_LSS/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2434340/BLACK_BOX_LSS/
